result.explanation: Conditional rule: revision-guarded mutations occur only when expect equals the current revision; successful rollback restores retained snapshot value but advances the current revision. Save/drop affect retention without changing revision.
result.mapping: config.initial -> value; state revision -> revision; retained IDs and immutable snapshots -> snapshots/saved; event.expect guards writes and rollbacks.
result.assumptions: Inputs satisfy the stated legal contract. State is initialized from config when null and otherwise is the prior returned opaque state.
result.holds: function holds(input,output){if(!applies(input)||!Array.isArray(output)||output.length!==input.events.length)return false;var c=input.config,v=c.initial,r=0,a=[],m={},u={},z=[];function eq(x,y){return JSON.stringify(x)===JSON.stringify(y)}function out(st){var q={};for(var i=0;i<a.length;i++)q[a[i]]={value:m[a[i]].value,revision:m[a[i]].revision};return {status:st,value:v,revision:r,snapshots:a.slice(),saved:q}}for(var i=0;i<input.events.length;i++){var e=input.events[i],st;if(e.type==='write'){if(e.expect!==r)st='conflict';else{v=e.value;r++;st='written'}}else if(e.type==='save'){if(u[e.id])st='exists';else{u[e.id]=1;m[e.id]={value:v,revision:r};a.push(e.id);if(a.length>c.keep){var x=a.shift();delete m[x]}st='saved'}}else if(e.type==='rollback'){if(e.expect!==r)st='conflict';else if(!m[e.id])st='missing';else{v=m[e.id].value;r++;st='rolled_back'}}else if(e.type==='drop'){if(!m[e.id])st='missing';else{delete m[e.id];a.splice(a.indexOf(e.id),1);st='dropped'}}else return false;z.push(out(st))}return eq(z,output)}
